recognize_zh: BCL2 染色中黏膜固有層被大片密集、強陽性的淋巴細胞充滿，腺體上皮為陰性並被浸潤細胞包圍；在沒有生發中心結構的瀰漫 B 細胞浸潤中 BCL2 陽性，配合 CD20、CD43 共表現，支持黏膜相關淋巴組織淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）。
features: Dense diffuse BCL2-positive lymphoid infiltrate filling the lamina propria
Residual BCL2-negative glandular epithelium surrounded by the infiltrate
Focal positive lymphocytes within gland epithelium
Strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining of small lymphoid cells
No BCL2-negative germinal centers identifiable in this field
describe_en: BCL2 immunostain shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate of strongly positive small lymphoid cells occupying the lamina propria and surrounding BCL2-negative residual glands. Occasional positive cells are present within the glandular epithelium. No BCL2-negative reactive germinal centers are identified in this field. These cells are reported to co-express CD20 and CD43; the findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: BCL2 stains normal T cells and mantle/marginal B cells too, so reactive cases are identified by BCL2-negative germinal centers, lack of CD43 co-expression on B cells, and polyclonality.
FL shows BCL2 within neoplastic follicles that co-express CD10 and BCL6 and carry t(14;18).
MCL is also BCL2-positive but co-expresses CD5 and cyclin D1.
